text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, I'm invited to join Mejiro Bright for a conference at the Mejiro estate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The discussion concerns how to move forward through the current trend in racing. It heavily emphasizes speed, when the family's goal has forever been producing well-rounded runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright seems to be unaffected. She is determined to continue, like always, to protect the Mejiro name.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She pledges to represent the new generation of Mejiros and stand up against the changing times by winning the spring Tenno Sho.
